Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misaggregated two distinct studio albums, "Cantora 1" (2009) and "Cantora 2" (2009), into a single item labeled "Cantora (2009)". Despite WebSurfer correctly listing both entries under Studio albums, the Planner counted them as one, leading to an incorrect total of 2 instead of the correct 3 (including "Corazón Libre" (2005)).
